summary: The note is a short biography of Khasim Mirza, a basketball player born to an Indian father and a Filipina mother. It traces his university career with the University of Santo Tomas Growling Tigers, his stint with the Philippine Patriots in the ASEAN Basketball League, and his selection in the 2010 PBA draft by Meralco Bolts.
one_line: Khasim Mirza is a Filipino-Indian basketball player whose career ran from UST and the Philippine Patriots to the Meralco Bolts in the PBA.
key_facts: Khasim Mirza was born to an Indian father and a Filipina mother.
Mirza played for the University of Santo Tomas Growling Tigers in the University Athletic Association of the Philippines for three seasons.
Mirza's time with the University of Santo Tomas Growling Tigers covered the seasons from 2007 to 2009.
Khasim Mirza played for the Philippine Patriots in the Asean Basketball League from 2009 to 2010.
Khasim Mirza was drafted 16th overall in the second round of the 2010 PBA draft.
The team that drafted Khasim Mirza in the 2010 PBA draft was Meralco Bolts, described as a PBA expansion team.
